_comment: Two independent trees. (1) years -> semesters -> subjects -> items: a subject is a folder (e.g. assets/guides/year-1/sem-1/cc104/); subject shape {id, code, title, items: []}, each item one numbered week or freeform 'special' entry {id, kind: "week"|"special", label, order, week?, html?, pdf?} (week only on kind:"week"; html/pdf are paths relative to this file, an item needs at least one). (2) references -> items: general material not tied to any year/semester/subject (e.g. assets/references/web-development/); category shape {id, label, items: []}, each item {id, title, order, html?, pdf?}. Both start empty — publish from /admin.html and entries land here automatically. order controls sidebar/library sort order in both trees. Nothing in script.js needs to change when subjects, items, or reference categories are added — manual editing works too.

subjects.title: Physical Activities Towards Health and Fitness

items.label: Week 1 — Anatomical Directions & Major Muscle Groups
